data.review_body:
Temu was once an accessible shopping experience. It has deteriorated drastically in the last few months and recently it has no after sales support or customer service. One is confronted with automatic replies that make no sense. Quality has reached an all time low and prices have increased almost double compared to other Chinese sites. One cannot order without having at least 20€ in your basket, they have other options from their local warehouse but the shipping is not free and the products are useless. I have been a long time customer but the condions they offer now are miserable and to make it worse ordering from Europe one has to pay import charges making the prices rocket sky high. Not worth it anymore until Temu makes changes to their policy. 
UPDATE:
It Not possible to talk to an agent on your chat platform, they are never available. The only help provided is automatic replies which makes no sense and does not help to sort out the issue.
data.review_headline: TEMU has reached a point of no return.

Well I've meant to text you and tell all of you, that I messed up.
(You probably don't get this kind of information.)
I was angry mostly because I was talking to a machine....but the machine was (mostly) telling me that I was as going to get the pruners. Plus when I got a look at my order it showed the pruners plus the items I received. I don't remember the name the lady that I texted last. She told me exactly what happened and how to get the right answer. I did exactly what she said and it showed me that I was wrong. If I hadn't been in the hospital, I would have written this a couple of weeks ago. However you've given me a chance to do it now. I apologize to any agent that I spoke with. I was just wrong in a dozen ways. I'm glad you sent this because It just opened the door for me to apologize. So thanks to all for your professionalism. That too is is a dying part of so many good companies. So thank you very much.

data.review_body: I used to like Temu. The prices were reasonable and I understood why they needed to put a 20€ or 25€ minimum. But the most recent purchase that I made, I found out that we had to pay important charges, not shipping fees but import charges on non EU goods and as we know, majority of Temu products don't come from suppliers based in the EU. So in the end, the "promotions" to cut prices that usually were put on my purchases to make it overall cheaper ended up amounting to even more than the original price without the discount due to those stupid costs. And I know that the EU is doing that as retaliation for the US tarifs and all but it is frustrating and becoming increasingly costly to buy from Temu. Temu has a specific brand, we are here to get products at a cheap price with no shipping fast, occasionally they have value for our money. But now I am thinking of shifting to another platform because on a 45€ purchase, why do i end up paying 65€.It's a difference that I would prefer to put into shipping costs. Also had issues with the size being way smaller than expected so wouldn't recommend the app. Capitalism ruined everything yet again.
